name: iodine-headless
description: The repository's one Node toolchain (ADR 09 §4): TypeScript sources build with esbuild, L3 runs on vitest, L4 on Playwright, the sample application's styles build with Tailwind.

scripts.build:js: node src/Iodine.Headless/js/build.mjs --root src/Iodine.Headless --outdir wwwroot --clean wwwroot --configuration Debug --entry js/initializer.ts=Iodine.Headless.lib.module
